song_story.overview: Deja Vu is built around a nightmare loop — the singer keeps returning to the same painful memory, trapped in a fog, holding onto a pain she can't let go of even as she begs for it to just be a trick of the mind. Partway through, a hand reaches for her through the dark and she chooses to follow it, closing the song by declaring herself 'saved.' Dreamcatcher made its name mixing rock and metal textures into girl-group pop with recurring horror and nightmare imagery, and Deja Vu fits squarely into that dark, cinematic register rather than typical bright K-pop romance.
song_story.cultural_root: The recurring word 악몽 (nightmare) and its aftermath aren't unique to Korean culture, but Dreamcatcher's whole concept deliberately breaks from the K-pop norm of cheerful, love-focused lyrics — using horror-film structure (haunting, salvation, a guiding hand in the dark) as emotional metaphor for anxiety and being trapped inside your own repeating thoughts, which resonated strongly with fans dealing with real mental health struggles.

verse_1.lines: 빛을 잃은 너의 두 눈동자여bicheul ireun neoui du nundongjayeo / 지난 모든 기억들을 지워 줘jinan modeun gieokdeureul jiwo jwo / 짙어진 안개 사이로jiteojin an-gae sairo / 멀리 떠나온 길meolli tteonaon gil / 시린 흔적만을 남긴 채sirin heunjeongmaneul namgin chae / 기억 끝을 잡아 봐도 끝내 오래 더 오래gieok kkeuteul jaba bwado kkeunnae orae deo orae
verse_1.literal: Your two eyes that lost their light / erase all the memories that came before
verse_1.context: 빛을 잃은 눈동자 — 'eyes that lost their light' — is classic horror-adjacent imagery, describing someone (possibly a past version of herself) drained of life. Asking to have memories erased frames forgetting as the only escape available.

pre_chorus.lines: 깊은 침묵에 잠들어gipeun chimmuge jamdeureo / 모든 걸 버린 그날처럼modeun geol beorin geunalcheoreom / 매일 더 괴로워져maeil deo goerowojyeo / 끝없이 눈앞에, oh, déjà vukkeuteopsi nunape, oh, déjà vu / 난 이 숨결이 허락되는 날까지nan i sumgyeori heorakdoeneun nalkkaji / 다신 너를 놓을 수 없어dasin neoreul noeul su eopseo
pre_chorus.literal: Through the thickening fog / a road I've traveled far from / leaving behind only a cold trace
pre_chorus.context: 짙어진 안개 (thickening fog) is a visual stand-in for confusion and disorientation — she's moving but can't see clearly where, which mirrors the deja vu sensation of being somewhere familiar without knowing why.

chorus.lines: 우린 모든 순간 함께 할 테니urin modeun sun-gan hamkke hal teni / 내 곁에서 더 멀어지지 마nae gyeoteseo deo meoreojiji ma / Eh, 이 순간이 전부 거짓이길Eh, i sun-gani jeonbu geojisigil / Uh, 잠시 스쳐가는 착각이길Uh, jamsi seuchyeoganeun chakgagigil / 젖은 눈물로도 뒤늦은 후회로도jeojeun nunmullodo dwineujeun huhoerodo / 돌아갈 돌아갈 수 있다면, yeahdoragal doragal su itdamyeon, yeah
chorus.literal: Even holding onto the end of a memory, in the end, for so long, even longer / falling asleep in deep silence / oh, now holding this pain / just like the day I threw everything away
chorus.context: 깊은 침묵에 잠들어 — 'falling asleep into deep silence' — treats silence as something you sink into, almost like drowning, reinforcing the horror-movie register of being pulled under by something you can't fight.

bridge.lines: 모든 걸 버린 그대처럼modeun geol beorin geudaecheoreom / 매일 더 선명해져maeil deo seonmyeonghaejyeo / 끝없이 눈앞에 oh, déjà vukkeuteopsi nunape oh, déjà vu / 난 이 숨결이 허락되는 날까지nan i sumgyeori heorakdoeneun nalkkaji / 다신 너를 놓을 수 없어dasin neoreul noeul su eopseo / 우린 모든 순간 함께 할 테니urin modeun sun-gan hamkke hal teni
bridge.literal: As long as this breath is still permitted to me / I can't let go of you again / because we'll be together through every single moment / don't drift any further from my side
bridge.context: 숨결이 허락되는 날까지 — 'until the day my breathing is [still] permitted' — an oddly formal, almost fated phrasing for staying alive, as if life itself is a temporary permission rather than a given.

climax.lines: 내 곁에서 믿어왔던 모든 진실이nae gyeoteseo mideowatdeon modeun jinsiri / 거짓들로 나를 뒤덮었으니geojitdeullo nareul dwideopeosseuni / Oh-ah, 어둠 속 한 줄기 빛처럼Oh-ah, eodum sok han julgi bitcheoreom / 손잡아 준 너를 따라가sonjaba jun neoreul ttaraga / 너를 따라가neoreul ttaraga / 너만을 위해 내 전부를 걸고서neomaneul wihae nae jeonbureul geolgoseo / 아픈 상처가 깊어져도apeun sangcheoga gipeojyeodo / 모든 순간들이 꿈인 것처럼modeun sun-gandeuri kkumin geotcheoreom / 네 곁에서 멀어지지 않아ne gyeoteseo meoreojiji ana
climax.literal: Oh-ah, like a single ray of light in the dark / I follow you, who took my hand / I follow you
climax.context: This is the turning point of the song — after multiple verses trapped in fog and silence, a 손 (hand) reaching through darkness becomes the rescue image, echoing the 'save me' motif common across a lot of Korean pop but rendered here in a much darker, more gothic key.

artist_context: Dreamcatcher built its identity around a rock/metal-infused sound and recurring nightmare concept across multiple mini-albums, distinguishing the group from most girl groups' brighter pop concepts. Deja Vu continues that thread, using dream and horror imagery as metaphor for anxiety, obsession, and eventual release from it.
honorific_level: informal — 반말, delivered like an internal monologue inside a dream rather than direct address

grammar_highlights.usage: 'Even if / even though.' 잡아 봐도 = 'even if I try to grasp it' — used to show effort that doesn't pay off, reinforcing the feeling of being stuck.
'Until the day that ___.' 허락되는 날까지 = 'until the day it's permitted' — frames an ongoing state as having a fated, uncertain endpoint.
'Like/as.' 한 줄기 빛처럼 = 'like a single ray of light' — the pivotal simile marking the shift from despair to rescue.
